design.quote: Using 7 T resting-state functional MRI in 22 healthy volunteers, we mapped out the acute effects of matched doses of 20 mg 2C-B, 15 mg psilocybin and placebo across spatiotemporal benchmarks of functional brain organisation.

findings.quote: 2,5-dimethoxy-4-bromophenethylamine (2C-B) is a psychedelic phenethylamine reported to produce less dysphoria and subjective impairment than the psychedelic tryptamine psilocybin.
findings.text: 2C-B is a psychedelic phenethylamine reported to produce less dysphoria and subjective impairment than the psychedelic tryptamine psilocybin.

findings.quote: Consistent with our hypothesis, we found that 2C-B exhibits empirical properties similar to classical psychedelics, including network desegregation and increased spontaneous BOLD complexity, irrespective of variations in rsfMRI thought content or effect intensity.
findings.text: 2C-B exhibits empirical properties similar to classical psychedelics, including network desegregation and increased spontaneous BOLD complexity.

findings.quote: Eliciting similar behavioural effects, 2C-B also produced comparable increases in complexity to psilocybin.
findings.text: 2C-B produced comparable increases in complexity to psilocybin while eliciting similar behavioural effects.
